headline: Apple rolls out iOS 27.2 with enhanced Siri AI features and new language support
summary: Siri can now recall past conversations and access more data sources. The update also adds support for five new languages.
details: Apple's latest operating system update, iOS 27.2, brings significant enhancements to Siri's AI capabilities. Users can now ask Siri to recall previous conversations, making interactions more fluid and context-aware. The AI assistant can also draw information from a wider range of sources, including photos in Messages, calendar invite attendees, and voicemails.

Further refining the user experience, Siri AI now allows for granular text selection, enabling users to copy specific parts of its responses. Additionally, users have the option to exclude certain apps from Siri, Search, and suggestions through the new Excluded Apps setting, giving them more control over data access.

The update introduces expanded language support for Siri AI, now including French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish. This global rollout aims to make Siri more accessible and useful to a broader international audience.

These advanced Siri AI features are available on iPhone 16 models and later, as well as the iPhone 15 Pro and iPhone 15 Pro Max. All other iPhone models will receive the general updates included in iOS 27.2.

Beyond Siri, iOS 27.2 includes other notable features such as editing captions and comments in Shared Albums, contextual action suggestions in Messages, and support for Google's SynthID watermarking tool for AI-generated images within Photos and Image Playground.

The iPhone Duo also receives specific enhancements, including Apple Pencil support and the Edge Light feature for video calls. watchOS 27.2 mirrors the Siri AI updates from iOS, while macOS 27.2 brings conversation recall and message suggestions alongside its usual bug fixes and security patches.
The 27.2 updates are also rolling out today for iPad, Apple TV, Vision Pro, and HomePod devices, ensuring a consistent experience across Apple's ecosystem.
